title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette to the live apps
body:
## Problem
The force arrows in the apps are told apart mostly by colour; some colour-blind users cannot tell weight, normal and friction apart.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
Arrows distinguishable by colour-blind users (for example with line style or labels), in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All three force arrows distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a rough-surface dataset and a second analysis to the mini-project
body:
## Problem
The mini-project ships one synthetic data file with one surface.

## Context
Students should compare two surfaces (wood and cloth) and see the uncertainty ranges overlap or not.

## Expected outcome
A second synthetic data set and an example script that compares the two estimated mu_s values with their ranges.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Data generated by code with a fixed seed
- [ ] Script prints both estimates and says whether the ranges overlap

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: stick-slip with a spring
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's second milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. Students ask why blocks and violin strings jerk instead of sliding smoothly.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add a stick-or-slide phase map computed by simulation
body:
## Problem
The Session 3 simulation tests one case at a time; there is no map over angle and friction coefficient.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 'A phase map of stick versus slide'.

## Expected outcome
A function that runs the simulation over a grid and a figure showing the boundary against tan t = mu.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Boundary matches tan t = mu to within one grid cell
- [ ] Runs in under 20 seconds

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: an animated ramp with force vectors
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a tilting ramp, force vectors and a stick-or-slide map; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The block lets go at atan(mu) within 0.1 degrees
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
